label: Checkbox
title: Checkbox
summary: Use Checkbox for an independent yes-or-no choice. People can select more than one option in a set.
corePrinciple: Keep the selected value separate from hover, focus, and availability. Always make the meaning of the choice clear.

anatomy.title: Selection at a glance
anatomy.description: The boundary locates the control. The checkmark makes the selected value explicit.
blocks: Locates the control in a list or form.

anatomy.note: Locates the control in a list or form.

configuration.title: Set a value and availability
configuration.description: Selection answers the question; availability controls whether that answer can change.

states.title: Feedback follows interaction
states.description: Hover and focus are temporary feedback. They do not change the saved selection.
blocks: Hover with a pointer or reach the control with Tab to see interaction feedback. The Figma states are Idle, Hover, Focus, Selected, Selected Hover, Focus Selected, Disabled Active, and Disabled.

sizing.title: Small control, clear space
sizing.description: Keep the Checkbox at its token-defined size. Use Checkbox Item when the choice needs a label and a larger selectable row.

content.title: Every choice needs a name
content.description: Use a visible description and a matching accessible name. A bare checkmark does not explain what was selected.

inContext.title: Select any that apply
inContext.description: Each option keeps its own value. Use a single-choice control when only one answer is allowed.

doDont.title: Keep choices explicit and independent
doDont.description: Give each control a clear meaning and preserve the difference between selection and availability.

sources.title: Follow the public Checkbox states
sources.description: The guide shows actual value and availability props; pointer and keyboard feedback comes from the component.
blocks: Declared, installed, and registry jfs-components versions are 0.1.60. Figma has eight visual states and 18×18 px masters. The package controls hover and keyboard focus internally; it exposes no state, indeterminate, or size prop. In the local preview pointer and Enter toggled selection, but native Space on the focused control did not; this is a current package/web interaction limitation. HitSlop aims to enlarge touch bounds, but this guide does not claim a measured 44 px web target.
